details.title: SELECTED PROCESS
details.selectProcess: Select a process in the table.
details.loadCollector: No fresh telemetry files. Check that factory-telemetry is enabled, the game restarted and a map loaded.
details.collector.restart_required: factory-telemetry is enabled on disk but not loaded by this process. Close Factorio completely and restart. Keep the current mod set when loading the map.
details.collector.disabled: factory-telemetry is disabled. Enable it in Mods, restart Factorio and load the map with the current mod set.
details.collector.not_installed: No enabled factory-telemetry found in the game profile. Install the mod for your Factorio version and enable it in Mods.
details.collector.starting: Factorio is still starting. Waiting for initialization and map loading.
details.collector.awaiting_map: The game loaded the mod. Load a map with factory-telemetry enabled; telemetry is produced while the map runs.
details.collector.awaiting_export: The map loaded the collector script. Waiting for the first export; unpause the game so game ticks advance.
diagnostics.noTelemetry: No telemetry files from the current game process.
details.noCollector: No collector found for this process. Telemetry from another process is not associated with it.
details.gatewayUnavailable: Gateway unavailable. Showing the last received snapshot.
details.noFreshData: No fresh data: check game pause and collector operation.
details.copyNotice: Data from a separate test copy of the save. The original game is not connected to this bridge.
details.gameNotice: Source confirmed by PID. Telemetry reading available.

topics.rollingWindow: {complete}. Measurement window: {seconds} game seconds. Age on the right is file publication time. Stock excludes belts, pipes, inserter hands and player inventories.
topics.coverageComplete: Scan of all detected entities complete
topics.measurementWindow: STOCK · {seconds} game s measurement window · batched collection
topics.legacyWindow: STOCK · {seconds} game s scan · collector 0.2 required
diagnostics.offline: No response from 127.0.0.1:18741 · retry in 3 s
diagnostics.selectProcess: Select a process with available telemetry.
diagnostics.stale: Snapshot is stale. Game ticks do not advance while paused.
diagnostics.cache: Reading gateway cache · the interface does not trigger map scans

overview.title: FACTORY OVERVIEW
overview.rowMeaning: {name}. Output and consumption: averages per game minute. Arrow: output over 5 seconds relative to the 10-minute average. Stock and depletion estimates cover tracked inventories only.
overview.conditional: BASED ON 1-MIN FLOWS · DEMAND MAY CHANGE
overview.historyNote: Since observation began: {count} points · {networks} power networks
overview.scienceCoverage: Output: {production}/min; consumption: {consumption}/min. Bar shows output divided by consumption, capped at 100%.
overview.stockScope: Inventories and tanks only; excludes belts, pipes, fuel and players. Measurement window: {seconds} game s. Depletion assumes unchanged flows; stock accessibility is not guaranteed.
overview.stockUnavailable: Stock is incomplete or stale ({age} s). Depletion estimate unavailable.
overview.capacityAction: Check capacity and supply; output needs +{value}/min to reach 105% of consumption
overview.noDeficits: No deficits found in current measured flows. Potential demand from idle machines is not calculated yet.
overview.flowsUnavailable: No fresh production flows. Forecast paused.
energy.title: ENERGY AND POWER NETWORKS
energy.historyNote: {minutes} game min recorded · {count} points. Peak covers the observed window only.
energy.batteryScope: Battery charge is batched by surface and force, not by individual network.
energy.batteryUnassigned: Accumulator charge has not yet been assigned to individual power networks.
energy.batteryEstimate: Full charge / discharge in ≈ {minutes} game min if the current rate holds.
energy.batterySteady: No significant charge / discharge rate for a time estimate. Charge is measured in batches.
energy.insufficientHistory: Not enough history: at least 6 points over a game minute required.
energy.trendNeedsHistory: History keeps accumulating in other sections too.
energy.trendScope: Rate: {value} / game min. Estimate excludes new buildings, recipe changes and future demand.
energy.noReserve: Generator rating is a theoretical ceiling, not available reserve. Sources without measured ratings are excluded.
energy.noFuel: Fuel stock and steam supply are not measured yet.
production.title: PRODUCTION AND RESOURCE BALANCE
production.selectResource: Select a resource in the table
production.noRows: No resources match the selected filter.
production.noMachines: No producing groups found for this resource.
production.noBlockers: No blocking states found in linked recipes.
production.machineScope: Groups by recipe, all qualities. Scan ≈ {seconds} game s. Actual output of individual machines is not measured.
production.machineStale: Machine snapshot is stale; showing last known states.
production.stockScope: Stock measured in batches: scan ≈ {seconds} game s. Excludes belts, inserter hands, players and all pipes. Time is a conditional estimate at unchanged balance.
production.stockIncomplete: Stock indexing incomplete. Depletion time is not calculated.
production.stockStale: Stock snapshot stale. Stock and time shown as dashes.
production.historyNote: {points} points · game window {window}. Stock history starts on connection.
production.countHelp: Shown / total · number of resources with a deficit
production.stockScopeHint: Observed stocks. Time assumes unchanged balance; belts and player inventories excluded.
production.upsHint: Game tick speed for the entire map. Estimate over the last 10 real seconds.
logistics.title: LOGISTICS AND DELIVERY
logistics.mapHint: Actual train coordinates. Rail geometry is not transmitted.
logistics.requestsScopeHint: Requests from all chests on the selected surface and force. Their logistic network IDs are not transmitted yet.
logistics.observedHint: Game time during which a resource group's deficit appears continuously in received snapshots. This is neither an individual request's age nor delivery delay. For trains, observation of the current state.
logistics.historyHint: Blue: busy logistic robots. Green: busy construction robots. Utilization includes flight and charging; charging queues are not measured separately.
logistics.selectTrainEmpty: Select a train in the table or diagram
logistics.requestCoverage: Session-wide groups: {groups}; unsupported filters skipped: {skipped}. Up to 512 groups returned, prioritizing deficits.
research.title: SCIENCE AND RESEARCH
research.surfaceHint: Research is shared by the force. Surface selection limits only packs, stock and machines.
research.etaHint: Game-time estimate from progress of the same technology and level. Requires at least three points and ten game seconds; hidden when progress stops.
research.speedHint: Completion percentage points per game minute.
research.consumptionHint: Total measured normal-quality pack consumption per minute. Not a count of research units.
research.nominalHint: Research units × packs per unit. Excludes productivity and pack quality value. Not the exact number of remaining items.
research.selectTechnology: Select a technology in the queue
damage.title: DAMAGE ASSESSMENT
combat.indicatorActive: Attack in progress. Open damage assessment. Ends after 15 game seconds without enemy damage.
combat.normalHint: Disable alert visuals and notifications until app restart. Damage tracking continues.
combat.indicatorMuted: Alert mode disabled until app restart. Open damage assessment.
combat.coverageHint: Compares placement items with counted stock on the same surface and force at original quality. Stock presence does not imply robot access. Incomplete or stale scans do not confirm sufficiency.
combat.partialCosts: Incomplete calculation: cost or rebuilding record unknown. Unresolved losses: {value}.
combat.costScopeHint: First allowed placement item at original quality × structures not yet rebuilt. Excludes modules, contents, repairs and crafting ingredients.
resources.title: RESOURCES AND DEPOSITS
resources.reserveHint: Sum of finite resources in displayed resource chunks. Infinite resources excluded. Collector sees explored territory only.
resources.activeHint: Areas with confirmed stock decrease after at least three complete updates. Not the number of working drills.
resources.mapHint: Resource chunk diagram, without terrain or rails. Edge-adjacent chunks of the same resource form an area. Separate deposits within a chunk are not distinguished.
resources.sampleAgeHint: Age of the oldest chunk measurement in the area in game time. File age in the heading is not the age of all measurements.
resources.trendHint: Depletion uses three or more fully updated samples in game ticks; deposit consumption excludes mining productivity. Dashed line assumes constant observed depletion. Stock increases or area expansion reset history.
resources.measurements: Complete samples: {count}. Observation window: {minutes} game minutes.
resources.coverageComplete: Explored chunks covered. Areas grouped approximately by chunk adjacency.
resources.coveragePartial: Indexing incomplete or tracking limit reached. Depletion forecast unconfirmed.
resources.advice.observing: Estimate appears after three complete area updates.
resources.advice.unconfirmed: Wait for a fresh complete scan to estimate depletion.
resources.advice.infinite: Plan using actual mining flow on the PROD screen.
resources.advice.stable: No stock decrease detected in the observed window.
resources.advice.critical: Prepare a replacement area and raw material supply route.
resources.advice.extracting: Monitor depletion time as mining rate changes.
forecasts.title: FORECASTS AND BOTTLENECKS
forecast.reserveHint: Target stock equals observed average consumption × game minutes of reserve. Counted stock does not guarantee delivery to consumers.
forecast.basisHint: Observation stability estimate, not probability. Requires three consecutive snapshots and at least 15 game seconds. Stable operation requires 1–2 minutes of low-variation history; persistent deficit means negative balance for at least 80% of observed time.
forecast.noRisks: No risks match the selected filter
forecast.needHistory: Not enough history for a forecast
forecast.projectionHint: Dashed line: conditional continuation of average balance; shading: range for balance changes of one observed standard deviation, not a statistical guarantee. Stock is measured in batches. Actual future stoppages and deliveries are not predicted.
forecast.chainHint: Links from active recipes on the same surface and force. They do not prove physical line connections or provide exact consumer stoppage times. Links are not shown for non-normal quality.
forecast.scenarioHint: Changes apply only to the selected resource forecast. Measured flows and the risk table stay unchanged. Raw material, machine and transport limits are not considered.
forecast.extraHint: Additional output target to reach 105% of average consumption. Required increase, not a promised effect or machine count calculation.
forecast.action.power: Check power: {count} machines below full power.
forecast.action.output: Check unloading: {count} machines with full output.
forecast.action.capacity: Increase output after checking ingredient supply.
forecast.action.observe: Check demand changes and keep observing.
forecast.noActions: No recommendations for selected observations yet
forecast.staleActions: Wait for fresh flows for recommendations
forecast.currentRate: Current minute window: {value}/min. Display shows average over selected history.
